<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.BobTheBuilder: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Builds an artifact, as a dam, an embankment or a levee, into an elevation model: inside a polygon, the elevations are interpolated from points with the elevation of the artifact, and replace the ones of the raster where they are higher, or everywhere if erosion is enabled.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Build, Raster<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.BobTheBuilder`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The elevation model to modify. |
| `inArea` | vector file |  |  | The vector with the single polygon of the artifact, within the raster. |
| `inElevations` | vector file |  |  | The vector of the points with the elevations of the artifact, at least 4. |
| `pMaxbuffer` | double | m | `-1.0` | The maximum distance of the points used to interpolate a cell. If negative, the largest side of the bounds of the polygon. |
| `fElevation` | String |  |  | The field of the points with their elevation. |
| `doErode` | boolean |  | `false` | If true, the interpolated elevations replace the raster also where it is higher, lowering it. |
| `doUseOnlyInternal` | boolean |  | `false` | If true, only the points inside the polygon are used, else all of them. |
| `doPolygonborder` | boolean |  | `false` | If true, the raster elevations along the border of the polygon are added to the points, to join the artifact to the terrain. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The elevation model with the artifact. |
